note: max(0, area x target - canopy from the Meta canopy model ~2018-2020). Arithmetic, says nothing about whether the space exists. Target = _global.canopy_target_pct.

note: Modelled estimate; +-25-30% for a single neighbourhood.

note: Modelled estimate; +-25-30% for a single neighbourhood.

label: residents aged 0-14
note: Modelled estimate; +-25-30% for a single neighbourhood.

label: sites with canopy <5% within 150 m
note: Schools + nurseries + playgrounds + elderly clubs (Lesches Filias); counts derived from streets/sites_with_plantings.csv (canopy_pct_150m < 5).

label: share of sites with canopy <5% within 150 m
note: Missing (not zero) where the neighbourhood has no such site.

label: schools and playgrounds with canopy <5% within 150 m
new trees since 2024 per 1000 residents
note: Counts planted, not survival or shade. Missing where the neighbourhood is absent from the plantings file.

label: summer night temperature
note: Only where a sensor exists (has_sensor); never imputed. Correlation with trees, not proof of cause; sensor placement unknown (σημείωμα ομάδας).

label: PM2.5 estimate of the Municipal Community (CONTEXT ONLY)
note: Context only: trees do not change it and it is never used in any score. Community-level, May-Oct 2026 sensors.

label: satellite land-surface temperature, summer day 2016-2020
note: SURFACE temperature (ground and roofs) seen by satellite, NOT air temperature. Area-weighted mean of the City of Athens GIS layer angLST_Athens_UrbanAtlas (EXTREMA / ARTi), June-August daytime, 2016-2020, over 6,092 Urban Atlas polygons (treecover/metrics_dictionary.csv; licence not stated). Exists for all 144 neighbourhoods. Used by the roof score only. Barely follows tree cover in Athens (Spearman -0.09, engine/validation/VERDICT.md) and also flags hot bare hills.
